intended_message: The structural beam above the patio door is rotted and needs to be replaced.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Hey Lisa, I checked under the deck, that header over your patio door is rotted clean through.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Sorry, header? Do you mean like the trim on top of the door?

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: No, I mean the actual beam holding the weight above the door, it's all water damaged.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Oh okay, so you'd have to pull that beam and put a new one in?
